extracted.intended_audience: recording artists, record labels, managers, and submission/screening committees preparing GRAMMY entries
extracted.subtask_description: Screening and eligibility criteria for GRAMMY Award categories across genre Fields, specifying what recordings, performances, songs, and albums qualify and how they will be judged for category placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST ALTERNATIVE MUSIC PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes artistic excellence in an alternative performance by a solo artist, collaborating artists, established duo, or established group that embraces attributes of progression and innovation in both the music and attitudes associated with it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Often a less intense version of rock or a more intense version of pop; typically regarded as more original, eclectic or musically challenging; may embrace a variety of subgenres or hybrids; may include performances that do not fit other genre Categories. Performances on which a group receives artist billing are eligible here, even when the vocal features only one member. The entire group or collaborative performance, rather than presence of a lead vocal, determines eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST ALTERNATIVE MUSIC ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes artistic excellence in alternative music albums.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternative music embraces attributes of progression and innovation in both music and attitudes; often a less intense version of rock or more intense version of pop; typically more original, eclectic or musically challenging; may embrace various subgenres or hybrids and may include recordings that do not fit other genre Categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: R&B FIELD — general definition
rubrics_metrics.description: This Field recognizes excellence in country music (?) [Note: R&B Field entries follow].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page groups multiple R&B-specific Categories (performances, songwriting, progressive R&B albums, etc.) each with their own screening criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST R&B PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in a performance by an R&B solo artist, collaborating artists, established duos, or groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST TRADITIONAL R&B PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in traditional R&B performance and is intended for recordings that may incorporate additional elements associated with blues, gospel and jazz.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Traditional R&B may include such styles as soul, funk, neo-soul, and smooth jazz.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST R&B SONG — Songwriter's Award and Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in R&B songwriting that utilizes a stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility that reflects the broad spectrum of R&B music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Songs that contain samples or interpolations are eligible. A song must comprise melody and lyrics to be eligible in a songwriting Category and must have been released on a recording for the first time, or achieved prominence for the first time, during the current eligibility year.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST PROGRESSIVE R&B ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of progressive vocal tracks derivative of R&B.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for artists whose music includes more progressive elements of R&B and may include samples and elements of hip-hop, rap, dance, and electronic music; may incorporate production elements found in pop, Euro-pop, country, rock, folk, and alternative.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST R&B ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes artistic excellence in albums of R&B music.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST RAP PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in a performance by a solo rap artist, collaborating rap artists, established rap duos, or established rap groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vocal only.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST MELODIC RAP PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in performances that use the delivery of rap and melody over modern production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires a strong and clear presence of melody combined with rap cadence; inclusive of dialects, lyrics or performance elements from non-rap genres (R&B, rock, country, electronic, or more). Production may include traditional rap elements or elements characteristic of non-rap genres. Both the song and melody should fit these criteria to be accepted in this Category.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST RAP SONG — Songwriter's Award and Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in rap music songwriting that utilizes a stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility that reflects the broad spectrum of rap music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Songs that contain samples or interpolations are eligible. A song must comprise melody and lyrics to be eligible in a songwriting Category and must have been released on a recording for the first time, or achieved prominence for the first time, during the current eligibility year.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST RAP ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes artistic excellence in albums of rap music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vocal performances only.

rubrics_metrics.name: COUNTRY FIELD — general definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Field recognizes excellence in country music recordings that utilize a stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility that reflects the broad spectrum of country music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intent is to recognize country music that remains reminiscent of its culture’s legacy while also engaging contemporary forms that 'push the boundaries' but remain relevant in collective country music culture. Field includes recordings that are country in content as opposed to those with a 'country flavor' aimed at pop audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST COUNTRY SOLO PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in recordings of country music performances by solo artists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For singles or tracks; vocal or instrumental; solo artists only (with or without band accompaniment).

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST COUNTRY DUO/GROUP PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence in recordings of country music performance by established duos or groups, or collaborations (with significant performance by both/all collaborative artist(s) beyond accompaniment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings on which a group receives artist billing are eligible here even when the vocal features only one member. The entire group or collaborative performance, rather than presence of a lead vocal, determines eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST COUNTRY SONG — Songwriter's Award and Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in country music songwriting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Songs which contain samples or interpolations are eligible. A song must comprise melody and lyrics and must have been released on a recording for the first time, or achieved prominence for the first time, during the current eligibility year.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST COUNTRY ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: This Category recognizes excellence for albums across the country music spectrum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For albums; vocal or instrumental.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST NEW AGE, AMBIENT OR CHANT ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Category may incorporate elements and influences from diverse musical genres to serve artistic intentions and functional uses including: creating textural-focused atmospheric musical journeys; forming soundscapes for relaxation, meditation, introspection, or focus; fostering wellness or inner/spiritual awakening; making devotional offerings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings may include sacred or secular components from global sacred traditions or universal intent; may be improvisational or structurally composed; may be consonant or dissonant, contemplative or avant-garde; vocal music welcomed as well as solo or multi-instrumentals; may incorporate acoustic, synthesized or environmental sounds. Category includes environmental recordings where the recordist is the artist.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST IMPROVISED JAZZ SOLO — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes improvised jazz solos (including vocal jazz solos) of substantive content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not for embellishments or fills, written-out solos, or solos that demonstrate some jazz flavoring but belong in Pop or R&B Fields. Intent and content are overriding criteria. Solos may be taken from an instrumental or vocal single or track; track must be from an album released in the current eligibility year but may be from an album in another Genre Field. Soloist need not be group leader or top-billed artist. Two performers who solo equally or near-equally may be eligible as one entry at Academy discretion. Entries limited to two per artist and may only be made by the soloist or the soloist’s representative.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST JAZZ VOCAL ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of vocal jazz performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Jazz elements may include inflection, phrasing, arrangements, repertoire, and/or improvisatory variations. Vocal performances, styling and interpretation must be jazz in content (not merely jazz flavoring). Pop, R&B or other genre styles of vocal performance are not eligible even from established jazz artists. Vocal performance may be solo, duo, group, or collaboration and may be in any language. If vocalist(s) and instrumentalist(s) are billed equally, both may be eligible for a GRAMMY; Academy will determine appropriate Category based on number of vocal tracks versus instrumental tracks or total playing time. An entire album entered in Jazz Vocal may not be entered again in a Jazz Instrumental Category.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST JAZZ INSTRUMENTAL ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums by individuals or groups generally thought of as 'small jazz groups' (typically one to eight musicians performing jazz music, including straight-ahead and contemporary jazz).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May include albums with larger back-up ensembles that provide coloring/background to what is essentially a small group performance; extent of interaction between soloist(s) and large ensemble determines eligibility. Size of ensemble is not determinative; instrumental makeup and scoring are deciding factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST LARGE JAZZ ENSEMBLE ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence on albums of large jazz ensemble performance, primarily recordings with a 'big band sound.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generally ensembles must contain nine or more members to be eligible (excluding conductor/bandleader). Ensembles may be billed as ensembles or under solo artist name if featured band/orchestra leader. Recordings that use synthesizers to imitate the sound of a large jazz ensemble are not eligible. Large jazz vocal ensemble albums must be entered in Best Jazz Vocal Album.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST LATIN JAZZ ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin jazz albums by ensembles of any size that represent blending of jazz with Latin and Iberian-American, Brazilian and Argentinian tango music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vocal or instrumental.

rubrics_metrics.name: GOSPEL/CONTEMPORARY CHRISTIAN MUSIC FIELD — Field definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Field is distinguished from other Genre Fields by lyrical content explicitly embracing the Christian worldview.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Categories include performance/song awards and album awards for gospel and contemporary Christian music with specific screening rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST GOSPEL PERFORMANCE/SONG — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative vocal performance and in songwriting (if the song is new) of a traditional Christian, roots gospel or contemporary gospel recording.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For artists and songwriters (of new songs); singles or tracks; vocal only.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST CONTEMPORARY CHRISTIAN MUSIC PERFORMANCE/SONG — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative vocal performance and in songwriting (if the song is new) of a contemporary Christian pop, rap/hip-hop, Latin, or rock music recording.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For artists and songwriters (of new songs); singles or tracks; vocal only.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST GOSPEL ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of traditional or contemporary/R&B gospel music recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For choir or chorus albums, recognition goes to the choir director or choral director at Academy discretion. Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST CONTEMPORARY CHRISTIAN MUSIC ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of Contemporary Christian Music, including pop, rap/hip-hop, Latin, and rock.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST ROOTS GOSPEL ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in a solo, duo, group, or collaborative performance of traditional/roots gospel music, including country, Southern gospel, bluegrass, and Americana.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recordings of sermons are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration And Storytelling Recording.

rubrics_metrics.name: LATIN FIELD — general definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin music recordings that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of Latin styles and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Field includes multiple album categories with language and style-based eligibility thresholds (not including Brazilian music in some Categories).

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST LATIN POP ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin music recordings that reflect the broad spectrum of Latin pop and urban music styles and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with lyrics greater than 50 percent in Spanish or albums with music content primarily of a Latin genre in style (excluding Brazilian music) are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST MÚSICA URBANA ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Encompasses music greater than 50 percent or more Spanish lyrics, originating in reggaeton and other Latin urban styles, including rap, house, R&B, trap, and others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vocal or instrumental.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST LATIN ROCK OR ALTERNATIVE ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in Latin rock or alternative music recordings that utilize stylistic intention, structure, lyrical content, and/or presentation to reflect Latin music style and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums with lyrics greater than 50 percent in Spanish or albums with music content primarily of a Latin genre in style (excluding Brazilian music) are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST REGIONAL MEXICAN MUSIC ALBUM (INCLUDING TEJANO) — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in recordings of the regional music of Mexico (banda, norteño, corridos, gruperos, mariachi, rancheros, huapango) and Tejano music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligible albums utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of regional Mexican and Tejano styles and cultures. Albums with lyrics >50% Spanish or primarily traditional Mexican genre in style are eligible. Musical style is determinative, not performer ethnicity.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST TROPICAL LATIN ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in tropical Latin music recordings, including traditional and contemporary tropical styles like salsa, merengue, vallenato, cumbia, and bachata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of tropical Latin music style and culture are eligible. Albums with lyrics greater than 50 percent in Spanish or albums primarily of a Latin genre in style are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: AMERICAN ROOTS FIELD — Field definition
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in American Roots recordings that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to reflect the broad spectrum of American roots music (bluegrass, blues, folk, regional roots).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Field encompasses multiple subgenres and categories with specific instrumentational and stylistic criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST AMERICAN ROOTS PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in American Roots Music performance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category encompasses subgenres of the American Roots Field (bluegrass, blues, folk, and regional roots music).

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST AMERICANA PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in performances of Americana music: contemporary music incorporating elements of various American roots music and vocal styles resulting in a distinctive roots-oriented sound separate from pure forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While acoustic instruments are often present and vital, Americana often uses a full electric band.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST AMERICAN ROOTS SONG — Songwriter's Award and Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in songwriting in any of the subgenres encompassed in the American Roots Music Field (Americana, bluegrass, blues, folk, regional roots).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instrumentals are not eligible; song must contain lyrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST AMERICANA ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of Americana music: contemporary music that incorporates elements of various American roots music and vocal styles, creating a distinctive roots-oriented sound.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While acoustic instruments are often present and vital, Americana often uses a full electric band.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST BLUEGRASS ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in bluegrass recordings performed in vocal or instrumental styles that utilize bluegrass acoustic instrumentation and singing style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instrumentation includes variations of fiddle, banjo, guitar, mandolin, bass, and Dobro; production and sensibilities distinctly different from a pop approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST TRADITIONAL BLUES ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of traditional blues recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Traditional blues includes recordings with traditional blues song structures, harmonic structures and rhythms, and includes traditional blues instruments (acoustic/electric guitar, piano, organ, harmonica, horns, bass, drums). Includes subgenres like Delta, Piedmont, jump/swing, Chicago blues, and classic/Southern soul.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST CONTEMPORARY BLUES ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in contemporary blues recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes recordings that vary from traditional blues song and harmonic structures; may employ non-traditional blues rhythms such as funk, hip-hop, reggae, and rock; may include traditional and non-traditional instruments and contemporary production techniques.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST FOLK ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in folk recordings in modern and/or traditional vocal and instrumental styles, as well as original material by artists who utilize traditional and/or modern folk elements as basis for recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Folk music is primarily but not exclusively acoustic, with production and sensibilities distinctly different from a pop approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST REGIONAL ROOTS MUSIC ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes recordings of regional roots styles (Cajun, Hawaiian, Native American, Second Line brass band, polka, zydeco, go-go, swamp pop, others) with production and sensibilities distinctly different from a pop approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Native American music defined as recordings that contain traditional and contemporary Native American elements within composition and arrangement. For Hawaiian music recordings, Hawaiian language must be used in greater than 50 percent or more of vocal tracks on the album and eligibility will be determined by the Screening Committee.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST REGGAE ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of reggae music, including roots reggae, dancehall and ska.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Vocal or instrumental.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST GLOBAL MUSIC PERFORMANCE — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Intended for vocal and instrumental performances with strong elements of global cultural significance that blend music forms/techniques found in pop, R&B, dance, rap, and folk with unique music forms, local expressions and techniques found among the global diaspora originating outside the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combination should give a unique sense of melody, rhythm, harmony, and lyric that is of global appeal.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST GLOBAL MUSIC ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in albums of global music that incorporate global music elements uniquely found beyond traditional U.S. conventions or styles, including unique local expressions from across the globe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on excellence and quality of recordings and performances themselves, independent of a particular genre or style. Albums of reggae, Latin or European pop are not eligible and should be entered in other Categories as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST CHILDREN'S MUSIC ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in children’s music recordings that utilize stylistic intention, song structure, lyrical content, and/or musical presentation to create a sensibility reflecting the broad spectrum of children’s music.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These albums must be created and intended specifically for children. All children’s music recordings belong in this Category regardless of musical style. Children’s spoken word albums are eligible in Best Audio Book, Narration, And Storytelling Recording. Soundtrack albums of children’s movies are eligible in Best Compilation Soundtrack For Visual Media.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST AUDIO BOOK, NARRATION AND STORYTELLING RECORDING — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in spoken word albums (not including Spoken Word Poetry). Eligible: audio books, storytelling, non-musical drama, sermons, narrations with/without music collaboration, and instructional recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If recording has musical accompaniment but is primarily spoken work, narrator is eligible while musical accompanists may be identified in parentheses. Recordings accompanying children’s picture books are eligible if content is non-repetitive and otherwise meets album requirements. Recordings that feature song lyrics that are spoken or rapped are eligible in appropriate genre Categories. Incidental talk or conversation in a studio used as an accent to a musical recording does not constitute a spoken work performance. Compilations or excerpts of previously broadcast radio/TV shows, albums of sound effects, and environmental recordings are not eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST SPOKEN WORD POETRY ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in spoken word poetry albums. Spoken Word Poetry is an oral poetic performance art referring to the poem as well as performers’ aesthetic qualities (intonation, vocal inflections, rhythmic cadence, musicality).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums of spoken word poetry with or without music collaboration are eligible. If recording has musical accompaniment but is primarily spoken word, spoken word artist is eligible while musical accompanists may be identified in parentheses. Recordings that feature song lyrics that are spoken or rapped are eligible in appropriate genre Categories. Incidental talk or conversation used as studio accent does not constitute a spoken word poetry performance. Compilations/excerpts of previously broadcast shows, albums of sound effects, and environmental recordings are not eligible; television shows, albums of sound effects and albums of environmental recordings are not eligible in this Category.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST COMEDY ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in comedy recordings, including spoken word stand-up comedy and musical/novelty recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New comedy performance albums, studio or live, audio only or part of a video project are eligible. Compilations/excerpts from current year radio/TV program or new recordings of comedy performance first aired on TV within five years of release date are eligible. Compilations/excerpts from non-current year broadcast programs, audio books (even if humorous), albums of sound effects, and albums of environmental recordings are not eligible and may be entered in other Categories as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST MUSICAL THEATER ALBUM — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: For recordings of the score of a musical theater work created to support an underlying dramatic intention or theme; honors excellence in performance(s) and production of musical theater recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Elements of corresponding stage production should not be considered in evaluating the recording. Recordings of revues that reflect a dramatic theme (including songs from a specific musical or repurposed preexisting material) are eligible. Eligible entries must be recordings created to support an underlying dramatic intention or theme. Benefit/tribute concerts featuring performances of various musical show songs by a specific songwriter and recordings of concert tours are not eligible. Non-musical theater performance albums are not eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST COMPILATION SOUNDTRACK FOR VISUAL MEDIA — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in soundtrack compilation albums comprised of predominantly song or non-original instrumental compositions, created specifically for or as a companion to a current legitimate motion picture, television show/series, video game, or other visual media production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Albums must be greater than 50 percent song compilation and may include previously released material. At least two-thirds of musical tracks must have been used in the visual media. For documentary/biopic works, an eligible soundtrack must contain 50 percent or more newly recorded music. Category placement determined by predominant nature of newly recorded music (song or score) and visual medium must predominantly feature new recordings. Greater than 50 percent of playing time on an otherwise eligible television soundtrack must be derived from new episodes/programming that airs during GRAMMY eligibility year. Configurations not meeting general eligibility (DVDs or video games not available as stand-alone audio streams/releases) are not eligible. Live concert films, live/filmed stage shows, musical/variety TV shows, musical documentaries primarily focused on live performance or 'making of' works, and soundtrack albums that are greatest hits/career retrospectives are not eligible. Albums/songs released during current eligibility period but belonging to visual media releasing next year have two options: (1) enter current year in other Categories (and not be eligible next year in Music For Visual Media Field) or (2) enter following year provided they were not entered in any Category during current year. Albums will only be eligible in their respective Category (Compilation or Score); songs in Song Written For Visual Media; they will also be eligible in other song Categories if they fulfill the 'track from a previous year is eligible' rule.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST SCORE SOUNDTRACK FOR VISUAL MEDIA — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in score soundtrack albums comprised predominantly of original score created specifically for, or as a companion to, a current legitimate motion picture, television show/series or other visual media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At least two-thirds of musical tracks must have been used in the motion picture/television show/series. Greater than 50 percent of music on an otherwise eligible television soundtrack must be derived from new episodes/programming airing during the GRAMMY eligibility year. Eligible orchestrations may include vocal coloring (not songs) used in overall orchestra texture (choral groups or solo voices with/without words or syllables). Soundtracks of live concert films, live/filmed stage shows, musical/variety TV shows, and musical documentaries primarily focused on live music performance are not eligible. Same timing/options for media releasing next year as in Compilation Category.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST SCORE SOUNDTRACK FOR VIDEO GAMES AND OTHER INTERACTIVE MEDIA — Screening Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in score soundtrack albums comprised predominantly of original scores created specifically for, or as a companion to, a current video game or other interactive media released within the qualification period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: At least two-thirds of the musical tracks for the album must have been used in the shipped game product (in-game, live action play or cinematics). Album releases adhere to same timing guidelines where media product and soundtrack album are often not in same eligibility year; Academy recognizes timing discrepancies and adjusts accordingly. Eligible scores may include vocal coloring (not songs) when used in overall texture. Same two-option timing rules for albums/songs released in current eligibility period but belonging to media releasing next year.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST SONG WRITTEN FOR VISUAL MEDIA — Songwriter's Award and Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in songwriting for songs with melody and lyrics written specifically for and used in a motion picture, television show/series, video game, or other visual media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Film version of the song may be entered even if different from version entered in other Categories. Same two-option eligibility/timing rules for media releasing next year apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST INSTRUMENTAL COMPOSITION — Composer's Award and Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in instrumental composition; open to any original non-classical composition without lyrics first released on a recording during the eligibility year, including original instrumental themes/main titles for motion pictures/television, jazz compositions and new composition backing spoken word entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instrumental compositions with 'vocal coloring' are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST ARRANGEMENT, INSTRUMENTAL OR A CAPPELLA — Arranger's Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in instrumental arrangements on instrumental recordings or a cappella arrangements on vocal a cappella recordings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open to singles or tracks from albums released during current eligibility year. An arrangement is organization of structure, rhythm, melodies, and harmonies for instruments/voices into a cohesive performance piece or recording. An arrangement can be a development, enhanced adaptation or considerable reworking of an original composition and may include dynamics, modulations, tempo variations, improvisation, and various textures. An instrumental recording with 'vocal coloring' is eligible; a vocal arrangement with 'instrumental coloring' is eligible. No arranger may be entered more than twice in the same arranging Category for arranging entries accompanying the same artist.

rubrics_metrics.name: BEST ARRANGEMENT, INSTRUMENTS AND VOCALS — Arranger's Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognizes excellence in arrangements that feature instrumental and vocal performance in any combination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open to singles or tracks from albums released during current eligibility year. Arrangement defined as organization of structure, rhythm, melodies, and harmonies into cohesive performance; may include dynamics, modulations, tempo variations, improvisation, and various textures. No arranger may be entered more than twice in the same arranging Category for arranging entries accompanying the same artist.
